description: List every domain in the account with its Cloudflare eligibility: `state` is eligible / warn / blocked / connected / inprogress, each with a human-readable reason (DNSSEC live, custom nameservers, uses Porkbun hosting, etc). Read this BEFORE queueing so you can tell the user what will move and what won't. Works even when the Cloudflare account isn't connected yet, so you can plan while the user authorizes.
name: list_cloudflare_inventory
title: List Cloudflare Inventory
